- 国会需在下月前通过拨款以避免政府停摆，民主党拟借此阻挡伊朗战争经费（[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/11/20/g-s1-154582/up-first-newsletter-democrats-iran-war-trump-xi-jinping-iowa-army)、[路透社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxPUDZZTmpNTGpqLUMwR0JBZUJuaVBuMDAwYVpVanpkNTJDSGpNMEkxdXlSX1JkSDJpaG1SNUlmMnJZTHZ2Y192UmFKSjlGazN5UE9hZEJfcmFwdzVGWFE0QWk3OXBGWEpudkV5bTdiLVEwWjJicDFrTHJWVGVQT2RNMlBYZ3pMMmhQTHhKRnJ1QktWbGhVWWxRb0paRGZvdVNDdlRJNEd1N1lEbG9LOU1mTURPZE9CZlVvUk5j?oc=5)）
